description: This file contains an implementation of the RetrieveFeaturesLiveCommand interface, representing an immutable command for retrieving features in a live query context. It extends an abstract class and provides static factory methods, overriding setDittoHeaders, and an answer method for building responses.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturesLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the RetrieveFeaturesLiveCommand interface which allows creating and configuring retrieve features commands in a live query context.

methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of RetrieveFeaturesLiveCommandImpl from a Command object.

methods.description: Sets Ditto headers by creating a new command with specified headers, supporting immutable pattern.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides a builder to generate responses for the command.
